fact: A 1.0 litre sample of fuel could not be provided.
offence: Breach of Article 6.5.2 of the FIA Formula One Technical Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the team representative of Car 77 (Valtteri Bottas). The car was unable to provide the required fuel sample. There were no mitigating circumstances. The Stewards have received a request from Alfa Romeo F1 Team Stake to allow Car 77 to start the race. The Stewards therefore grant permission for Car 77, Valtteri Bottas to start the race.
rules_referenced: Article 6.5.2 of the FIA Formula One Technical Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
evidence presented. ### Tim Mayer Felix Holter ### Derek Warwick Nicky Moffitt
title: Infringement Car 77 Failure To Provide A Fuel Sample
to: The Team Manager, Alfa Romeo F1 Team Stake
